name: Titanforge Blade
description: A legendary blade forged in the heart of a dying star. Burns with eternal flame.
specialEffect: 20% chance to deal double damage and ignite the target for 5 ticks

name: Voidreaper Scythe
description: A scythe that tears through dimensions. Hits in a 3x3 area.
specialEffect: Attacks hit all enemies in a 3x3 area. 10% lifesteal.

name: Dragonfire Lance
description: A lance imbued with the essence of an ancient Inferno Dragon.
specialEffect: Immune to dragonfire. 15% chance to breathe fire on attack.

name: Crystal Maul
description: A massive maul carved from living crystal. Shatters defences.
specialEffect: Ignores 50% of target's defence. 5% chance to stun for 3 ticks.

name: Titan Lord's Crown
description: The crown of the Titan Lord. Radiates overwhelming power.

name: Spectral Cloak
description: A cloak woven from void energy. Makes the wearer partially invisible.
specialEffect: 25% chance to dodge incoming attacks completely

name: Infernal Wings
description: Wings torn from the Inferno Dragon. Allows limited flight.
specialEffect: Doubles run energy restoration. Immune to fall damage. Cosmetic wing effect.

name: Dragon Heart
description: The still-beating heart of an Inferno Dragon. Pulses with fire.
specialEffect: Used in Titan Forging to create dragon-tier equipment

name: Crystal Armor Shard
description: A shard of living crystal. Can be forged into powerful armor.
specialEffect: Collect 5 to forge Crystal Armor set at Titan Forge

name: Titan Essence
description: Pure essence of a Titan. The universal custom currency.
specialEffect: Currency for the Titan Shop and Titan Forging

name: Void Shard
description: A fragment of the void between dimensions.
specialEffect: Used in Titan Forging to create void-tier equipment

name: Golem Core
description: The magical core that animates a Crystal Golem.
specialEffect: Enhances Crystal Armor when used at Titan Forge

name: Arena Champion Token
description: Proof of surviving 10+ waves in the Titan Arena.
specialEffect: Trade to Arena Master for exclusive rewards

name: Titan Arena Cape
description: A prestigious cape awarded for surviving 25 waves in the Titan Arena.
specialEffect: +5% damage and accuracy in all combat styles

name: Shadow Amulet
description: An amulet that channels the power of the Void Reaper.
specialEffect: 10% chance to drain enemy prayer on hit. +15% magic accuracy.

name: Infernal Boots
description: Boots forged in dragonfire. Leave burning footprints.
specialEffect: Immune to ground effects (lava, poison tiles). +5% movement speed.

name: Ring of the Titans
description: A ring that embodies the power of all four TitanScape bosses.
specialEffect: +15% drop rate from all bosses. Forged from all 4 boss uniques.
